title: feat(console): an administrator configures the record page's tabs in place (#36499, PR 1 of 2)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Wq5utqEodnDCBh6heq37AG)_
Refs #36499

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：系统管理员在自建应用的记录详情页「…」里多了「配置页签」，可就地拖动排序、隐藏/恢复、改名后保存，所有人看到新的默认页签顺序；普通成员看不到入口。
- 为什么做：属于「记录页就地配置」专题的第一步（本卡第一个合并请求），替管理员省去进 Studio 改对象定义的绕路。
- 出错会怎样：只影响自建应用对象的记录页页签排列；保存写成对象的已发布定义，管理员可再次进入配置恢复原样，读者自己的拖动顺序不受影响。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

On the desktop full record page of an object whose package is writable, a workspace administrator who may author metadata gets 「Configure tabs」 in the record's 「…」 menu. It is not offered on a phone, in a drawer or a pane, or on an authored record page. Choosing it puts the page in an edit state in place:

- A bar across the top, with 「Configure tabs」 on the left and 「Cancel」 and 「Save」 on the right. It has the design-mode bar's look. The design-mode shell is reused unchanged: no change to DesignModeBar, designMode.tsx or unsavedEdits.
- The tab row becomes an editor. The administrator can:
  - drag tabs to reorder them (dnd-kit, keyboard too);
  - hide a tab into a 「Hidden」 area and show it again from there;
  - rename a tab;
  - hide the attachments tab.
- Some tabs cannot be moved, hidden or renamed in the editor. They are shown with a lock:
  - 审批 and 动态, which the page always draws last;
  - lists another package brings.
- 「Adjust field groups」 opens the object in Studio.
- The record stays on screen as the preview, in the draft's order. The reader's own arrangement is set aside while the edit state is open.
- 「Cancel」 writes nothing.
- Leaving with a change held asks first, through the existing unsaved-edits seam.

「Save」 writes the object's `relatedLists` over the object **as stored** (the layered read with `packageId`), never the served object. It saves a draft with the first-write pin (`ifNoneMatch: '*'`) into the object's own package, then publishes it. A refused publish resets that draft, and a pending Studio draft is refused with its own sentence. This mirrors the design-mode menu's save. All writes go through one seam, `resolveRecordTabsSaveTarget`, which returns `{kind: 'package', packageId}` for a writable package and `null` for anything else. PR 2 adds the installed `.custom` target there.

How the list is written:
- A tab is hidden by leaving it out of the object's own list.
- A rename becomes the entry's `label`.
- The stored entry's `columns` are kept.
- Entries the editor does not arrange (审批 / 动态 names, a list it does not offer) are kept after the entry they followed.
- If every tab is hidden, the save still writes a declared list (`['sys_approval_request','sys_activity']`). An empty list would read as "none declared".

Renaming follows the design-mode menu's rule (ruling (4) of #36363): only in the deployment's default language, and only where the shown name is the stored one.

Files:
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/recordTabsConfig.ts`: the pure model (catalog, draft, edits, the entries a save writes, the preview).
- `recordTabsConfigSave.ts`: the write.
- `RecordTabsConfig.tsx`: the hook, bar and editor.
- `recordTabsConfigIo.tsx`: the metadata client, stored list and default language. It sits behind `React.lazy` so the record page's module graph does not gain the metadata client's module.
- `RecordDetailView.tsx`: wiring only.
- `@object-ui/plugin-detail` `RecordPageColumns` takes an optional `tabRowEditor`, drawn in the tab row's place.
- `designMode.recordTabs` keys in all eleven console locales. zh-Hant is generated from zh-Hans.

## Tests

New, named for the card:
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/recordTabsConfig-36499.test.ts` (11): the catalog, the opening draft, edits, the entries a save writes, the preview, and item 6. Item 6 checks that the admin order is the new default, that a reader's dragged order stays over it, and that `EMPTY_RELATED_ARRANGEMENT` (「恢复默认顺序」) gives the admin order.
- `.../recordTabsConfigSave-36499.test.ts` (5): the stored object, not the served one; the pinned draft then publish; a pending draft refused; a refused publish resets; a read-only or unlisted package refused before anything is read; the seam.
- `.../RecordTabsConfig-36499.test.tsx` (8): the offered gate; the edit state; another package's list fixed; hide → Hidden → restore and Cancel writes nothing; drag + Save writes once; the leave prompt; rename open and closed.

- `ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/page-header-overflow-close-36499.test.tsx` (2): an entry that finished on the click closes the 「…」 menu; one still running keeps it open and busy until it settles.

No existing test was changed.

Patch round (CI at a9fc3dd56):
- Type Check UI `check:spec-symbols`: the local `ObjectLike` and `Session` collided with spec exports; renamed `RecordTabsObjectDef` and `RecordTabsSession`.
- Lint UI `object-ui/no-synthetic-event-trigger` and Test UI 1/16 `adr0054-ratchet`: the Escape the entry dispatched is gone; page:header closes the menu itself (above).
- Test UI 11/16 `consoleTopBar.height-12639`: the chrome offset under the tab bar is spelled as the bar's 3rem plus the page's own gap, not `top-14`.
- Test UI 4/16 `recordTabsConfigSave-36499`: the `unit` project runs with `isolate: false`, so the test's module mock of the assistant bus missed a module another file had loaded; the refresh announcement is now one of the save's doors.

<details><summary>Test runs (final head a9fc3dd56 unless noted)</summary>

- Run under `os-verify-lock` on 745f057c8, before the lazy split: `vitest run packages/i18n/ plugin-detail RecordPageColumns* app-shell RecordDetailView.* + the three new files` gave 21 failed files.
  - 20 `RecordDetailView.*` suites failed with "Cannot access 'authFetchSpy' before initialization". The new import chain reached `metadataClientFactory`, which mints its fetch at module load.
  - zh-Hant was stale.
- After the fix (a06a82731), the same command under the lock: `Test Files 212 passed (212) · Tests 2898 passed | 13 skipped`, then `@object-ui/app-shell type-check`, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Final head, under the lock: the three new files + `RecordDetailView.recordOpen*`: `Test Files 7 passed (7) · Tests 62 passed (62)`, plus `@object-ui/app-shell type-check`, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- Dependency closure `pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build` after merging origin/main: VERDICT command-exit 0.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **The entry's place in 「…」.** 「Configure tabs」 is the first of the record's own entries. It comes after 「Refresh」, which the record header puts first; measured menu: Refresh, Configure tabs, Share, Change Owner, Delete. A literal first place needs a change in `@object-ui/components` page:header and `@object-ui/react`, outside this card's file surface. This is raised as an open question in the report.
- **「Adjust field groups」** opens the object in Studio's Data pillar (`/studio/PKG/data?surface=object:NAME`), on its Records tab. Studio has no URL address for the Form tab yet; #36505 adds it.
- **Approvals / activity cannot be hidden** on a self-built object without a spec change (the spec refuses object-form built-in entries, and an own list cannot leave them out). They are shown fixed. Attachments and the object's own related lists hide faithfully by omission.
- **Undeclared to declared.** Saving an object that had no `relatedLists` writes one, so a relationship added later is not shown by default. That is the spec's semantics for a declared list.
- **The 「…」 menu now closes after an entry that finished on the click.** `page:header` (`@object-ui/components` containers.tsx) prevented the menu's close on every select, so an in-place change left it open over the editor (measured). Now an entry still running (it returned a pending promise) keeps the menu open with its row busy, as before; one that finished closes it, as Refresh does. Pinned by `ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/page-header-overflow-close-36499.test.tsx`.
- Only the desktop full page offers the entry. Installed (read-only) packages are not offered it yet (PR 2).

## Verification

Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 41 families. Each one ran on the final head and exited 0, and `--ran` reconciles 41 derived, 41 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a derived zero).

Browser: I booted `examples/app-showcase` (`objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin`, own port and DB) with the console rebuilt from this branch. Setup:
- A Studio-style writable package `com.qa.tabs` with `qtab_account` and three lookup children (Contacts, Deals, Tickets), each with one record.
- A plain member (admin create-user, then a read permission set assigned).

Measured:
- **Menu.** The admin's 「…」 reads Refresh, Configure tabs, Share, Change Owner, Delete. The member's reads Refresh, Share.
- **Entering the edit state.** Choosing the entry closes the menu and shows the bar and editor, at 1280 and 1440.
- **Hide and restore.** Hiding Tickets moves it to 「Hidden」, and Show brings it back.
- **Cancel.** It sends no metadata write (request log empty).
- **Leaving with a change held.** Leaving to Projects prompts "Leave without saving? Your tab changes will be lost.", and dismissing the prompt stays on the page.
- **Reorder, rename, save.** Dragging Deals left (keyboard) and renaming Contacts to People, then Save, sends `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qtab_account?mode=draft&package=com.qa.tabs` then `POST …/publish`. After a reload the order is Deals, People, Tickets, Attachments, Activity, and the member sees the same order.
- **A reader's own order.**
  - The member moved People left; then the admin hid Tickets and saved.
  - The member kept their own order: People, Deals, Attachments, Activity.
  - 「恢复默认顺序」 gave the admin order: Deals, People, Attachments, Activity.
- **Showing a hidden tab again.** The admin then showed Tickets again and saved; the order read back as Deals, People, Tickets, Attachments, Activity.
- **Field groups.** 「Adjust field groups」 lands on `/_console/studio/com.qa.tabs/data?surface=object%3Aqtab_account`.

**2-minute check:** sign in as an admin on a self-built object's record, open 「…」 and choose 「Configure tabs」. Expect a purple bar on top and the tab row turned into draggable chips with a 「Hidden」 line under them.

Screenshots (`/mnt/project-files/objectstack-seat2/shots/36499/`):
- `01-admin-record-menu-entry-1280.png`, `01-admin-record-menu-entry-1440.png`: the entry in 「…」
- `02-admin-edit-state-1280.png`, `02-admin-edit-state-1440.png`: the edit state
- `03-admin-hidden-area-1280.png`: Tickets in 「Hidden」
- `04-admin-reordered-renamed-1280.png`: Deals moved first, Contacts renamed People
- `05-admin-after-save-reload-1280.png`: after save + reload
- `06-admin-field-groups-studio-1280.png`: 「Adjust field groups」 in Studio
- `08-member-menu-no-entry-1280.png`: the member's 「…」 without the entry
- `09-member-own-order-kept-1280.png`: the member's own order kept over the new default
- `10-member-restore-default-order-1280.png`: 「Restore default order」
- `11-member-admin-order-1280.png`: the admin order after restoring

Files to read first, by risk:
1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/recordTabsConfig.ts`, `recordTabsEntries`: what a save writes, including keeping entries the editor does not arrange.
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/recordTabsConfigSave.ts`, `saveRecordTabs`: the stored read, pinned draft, publish, reset.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`: the preview object fed to the derivation and page schema, and the reader arrangement set aside while editing.
